title: E0063: LDAP injection
plain_english: This rule reports LDAP search calls where user-controlled input reaches the LDAP filter or query argument. Crafted input can change the meaning of an LDAP filter.
why_matters: LDAP injection can affect authentication and directory lookups, potentially allowing unauthorized access, disclosure of directory data, or unintended query results.
what_it_checks: Cases where user-controlled input reaches these calls, based on taint analysis and dynamic-expression heuristics
